title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium): customer-managed keys for review set data at rest
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents Customer Key onboarding, but does not state the planned review-set feature's default on arrival. The licensing checklist also omits that multiple-workload Customer Key requires the greater of the Exchange and Teams user counts, which could lead an administrator to under-license the tenant.
